name: GasGas EC 450F / FSE (four-stroke)
intro: GasGas's four-stroke enduros, first Yamaha-based, later their own engines.

H: Four-stroke motocross engines need frequent valve checks and oil changes. Follow the hour-based schedule in the manual, not the calendar.

recallNote: Off-road and trials models are often not in the NHTSA recall search. Ask a dealer for the make to run the frame number.
